message.content: {"text":" Check the dropdown’s positioning and overflow styles, especially its anchor logic, viewport boundary detection, `position`, `transform`, `left`/`right`, and any parent `overflow: hidden` rules. Verify the fix by testing on narrow viewports and near both screen edges, resizing the window, zooming the page, and confirming that the menu remains fully visible without clipping or horizontal scrolling. Use browser DevTools to inspect its bounding rectangle and ensure it stays within the viewport."}
